title: Standard of conduct
bodyText: . An owner issued a limited lines self-service storage producer license shall act in good faith, abstain from deception, and practice honesty and equity in all insurance matters.
bodyHtml: [§431:9A-177]  Standard of conduct.  An owner issued a limited lines self-service storage producer license shall act in good faith, abstain from deception, and practice honesty and equity in all insurance matters. [L 2021, c 110, §3]
